_why: The run suggestion (80%/90%) in h-mad-advisor-warn.sh: suggestive close-out with /handoff, its own throttle, escalation at 90%.

mutations.name: run-halt-ignored
mutations._mechanism: The run suggestion never fires: the 80% ceiling goes back to being prose nobody reads.

mutations.name: urgent-band-never-reached
mutations._mechanism: At 90%+ the note still suggests the full WRITE, which may not fit.

mutations.name: run-repeats-every-call
mutations._mechanism: The suggestion reprints on every tool call: the context bloat this hook exists to prevent.

mutations.name: escalation-is-throttled
mutations._mechanism: Crossing into 90% waits out the 80% interval, so the urgent note can arrive ten minutes late.
mutations.find: *) ;;                                    # entering a higher band, or garbage -> speak

mutations.name: run-shares-the-advisor-stamp
mutations._mechanism: One stamp for both halves: the advisor note silences the run suggestion.

mutations.name: soft-wording-dropped
mutations._mechanism: The suggestion loses the line that gives time to finish the task in hand (operator decision: suggestive, not obligatory).
mutations.find: No rush, and nothing is blocked: finish the task you are on and avoid starting a new large one, \
